946.speaker: Player_Romus
946.text: "I am truly overcome with emotion that so many of you came out to honor my daughter's marriage."

947.speaker: Player_Romus
947.text: "When it comes to one's meaningful relationships, it is quality that matters, not quantity. So I am not disappointed with today's rather sparse turnout."

948.speaker: Player_Romus
948.text: "On behalf of the entire Rizian royal family, thank you for joining us on this most joyous of occasions."

949.speaker: Player_Romus
949.text: "In this time of war, it is especially important for us to gather in celebration of the love in our lives."

953.speaker: Player_Romus
953.text: "I thank God for bringing us together to celebrate the union of these two souls."

960.speaker: Player_Romus
960.text: "In the fast-paced modern era, it is especially important for us to gather in celebration of the love in our lives."

961.speaker: Player_Romus
961.text: "I am particularly gladdened to so many of our South Merkopan neighbors here. It bodes very well for the alliance we are planning."

962.speaker: Player_Romus
962.text: "In particular, the presence of our GRACE partners in this hall fills my heart with gratitude."

969.speaker: Player_Romus
969.text: "It is particularly auspicious that our distinguished guests from Wehlen could be here."

970.speaker: Player_Romus

978.text: "I cannot tell you how overjoyed I am to see the members of House Toras out in full force."

982.speaker: Player_Romus
982.text: "I cannot tell you how overjoyed I am to see the members of House Sazon out in full force."

983.speaker: Player_Romus
983.text: "I am proud to extend our traditional Rizian hospitality to our guests from Pales."

992.speaker: Player_Romus
992.text: "Long ago, I promised my daughter that she could marry whomever she desired."

993.speaker: Player_Romus
993.text: "A royal wedding is an alliance in the truest sense of the word."

994.speaker: Player_Romus
994.text: "Like myself and my father before me, my daughter grew up knowing that whomever she married would impact the course of the kingdom and that of our royal house."

995.speaker: Player_Romus
995.text: "Today marks the dawning of a new age -- not only for the Royal Family, but for Rizia as a whole."

996.speaker: Player_Romus
996.text: "Providence smiled upon us when the Crown Princess of Rizia fell in love with a man who happened to be my ideal choice of Prince Consort."

1000.speaker: Player_Romus
1000.text: "I knew that when the time came, Vina would do what was right for her country and her future subjects."

1001.speaker: Player_Romus
1001.text: "It was not easy to keep that promise. But seeing the look in Princess Vina's eyes today, I knew it was all worthwhile."

1002.speaker: Narrator
1002.text: Axel wrapped an arm around Vina. They smiled out at the crowd.

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "The union you witnessed today is more than a mere love bond. It is an intertwining of destinies."

1007.speaker: Narrator
1007.text: Vina and Rico smiled through gritted teeth.

1008.speaker: Player_Romus
1008.text: "I am proud of the Princess for boldly following her heart, even in the face of pressure to act otherwise."

1012.speaker: Narrator
1012.text: Vina looked as if she was about to start crying again.

1013.speaker: Player_Romus
1013.text: "I did not choose my daughter's husband. Her marriage was preordained by the heavens."

1017.speaker: Player_Romus
1017.text: "The new Crown Prince had to be someone who would keep Rizia strong for years to come."

1021.speaker: Player_Romus
1021.text: "And I am proud that the good name of House Toras will live on in Vina and her descendents."

1025.speaker: Player_Romus
1025.text: "And while Vina's descendents may not bear the Toras name, I know they shall still carry forth our house's spirit."

1026.speaker: Player_Romus
1026.text: "Together, the Kingdom of Rizia and the Grand Duchy of Pales shall be greater than the sum of their parts."

1027.speaker: Player_Romus
1027.text: "Duke Reinhart, you have been a formidable ally and energy partner. I could not ask for a better son-in-law."

1028.speaker: Player_Romus
1028.text: "I trust Princess Vina and Prince Consort Axel to bring Rizia and Pales into the future together."

1029.speaker: Player_Romus
1029.text: "Mr. Sazon, you have been a formidable political ally. I could not ask for a better son-in-law."

1030.speaker: Player_Romus
1030.text: "Mr. Sazon, we have not always seen eye to eye politically. But I know you will take good care of my daughter."

1034.speaker: Player_Romus
1034.text: "I trust Princess Vina and Prince Consort Manus to bring Rizia into the future. Changes are coming that not even I can imagine."

1035.speaker: Player_Romus
1035.text: "With this marriage, the noble houses of Toras and Sazon will finally be in alignment."

1039.speaker: Player_Romus
1039.text: "Rico, you are not only my cousin -- you are my friend. I know you shall bear the mantle of Crown Prince with honor and dignity."

1040.speaker: Player_Romus
1040.text: "Duke Ricardus, you have been a formidable political ally. I could not have asked for a better son-in-law."

1044.speaker: Player_Romus
1044.text: "Duke Ricardus, we have not always seen eye to eye. But I know we both care for my daughter."

1045.speaker: Player_Romus
1045.text: "I trust Princess Vina and Crown Prince Ricardus to bring Rizia into the future while protecting our proud history and traditions."

1046.speaker: Player_Romus
1046.text: "With Vina on the Royal Council and Ricardus protecting Iza, this marriage is a harbinger of peace and stability for Rizia."

1050.speaker: Player_Romus
1050.text: "As Duchess of Valenqiris and Duke of Iza, Princess Vina and Prince Consort Ricardus will bring peace and stability to two corners of Rizia simultaneously."

1054.speaker: Player_Romus
1054.text: "Together, the Kingdom of Rizia and the Grand Duchy of Pales shall be strong enough to defeat anyone who stands in our way."

1058.speaker: Player_Romus
1058.text: "This union between the Royal Council and the House of Delegates shall bring peace and stability to our government."

1059.speaker: Narrator
1059.text: I heard a few discontented murmurs coming from the House Toras tables.

1063.speaker: Narrator
1063.text: I heard a few discontented murmurs coming from the Sazon tables.

1064.speaker: Narrator
1064.text: Loud cheers went up from the Toras tables.

1065.speaker: Player_Romus
1065.text: "May your heirs find their own way in life, unburdened by the expectations the House Toras name carries."

1066.speaker: Player_Romus
1066.text: "And the fact that the Prince Consort is willing to sacrifice his name to marry Vina speaks volumes about his dedication to the Crown."

1067.speaker: Player_Romus
1067.text: "Your children will be Torases. Their grandchildren will be Torases. Our house's name shall reverberate through generations upon generations."

1068.speaker: Player_Romus
1068.text: "Vina shall be the first Rizian queen not to take her husband's name. Not even my grandmother Lyza could accomplish that feat."

1069.speaker: Player_Romus
1069.text: "It does not matter what name your children bear. What matters is the legacy you pass on to them -- one of love, honor and integrity."

1073.speaker: Player_Romus
1073.text: "As is God's will, our noble house will hold the throne for millennia to come."

1074.speaker: Player_Romus
1074.text: "As we make merry today, let us not forget the brave sacrifices made by our troops."

1078.speaker: Player_Romus
1078.text: "I have a confession to make. Today is a celebration of love in more ways than one."

1082.speaker: Player_Romus
1082.text: "The Lord foretold that our kingdoms would be united one day. And lo, it has come to pass."

1083.speaker: Player_Romus
1083.text: "The Toras name is a small sacrifice to make compared to the glory that is to come."

1087.speaker: Narrator

1091.speaker: Player_Romus
1091.text: "Let the joy we share today be a reminder of what our soldiers are fighting for."

1095.speaker: Narrator
1095.text: Pabel gave me a startled look.

1096.speaker: Player_Romus
1096.text: "As we feast, I invite you to share not only in my daughter's happiness, but in my own."

1097.speaker: Player_Romus
1097.text: "Duchess Lucita Azaro has provided me with invaluable counsel over the past years. Now she will be taking on a new role: that of Queen Consort."

1101.speaker: Player_Romus
1101.text: "Duchess Lucita Azaro has provided me with invaluable counsel and support during the war. Now she will be taking on a new role: that of Queen Consort."

1102.speaker: Player_Romus
1102.text: "I speak of my cherished friendship with my head butler Pabel Adria, recently elevated to the status of Lord."

1103.speaker: Player_Romus
1103.text: "For those of you who don't know, I adopted a dog towards the beginning of my reign. He is the most precious thing in my life. Come here, Bruno!"

1110.speaker: Player_Romus
1110.text: "It is no secret that the Duchess of Montaklar and I have grown close. I am happy to have her by my side on this occasion."

1111.speaker: Player_Romus
1111.text: "The Duchess of Montaklar and I have grown close. I am happy to have her by my side on this occasion."

1112.speaker: Player_Romus
1112.text: "Let us not forget to thank the great and merciful God for the many blessings we enjoy today."

1116.speaker: Player_Romus
1116.text: "I'm going to assume that's your rumbling stomachs I'm hearing. Don't worry, we'll eat soon."

1117.speaker: Player_Romus
1117.text: "As you enjoy this sumptuous banquet, do not forget that it has only been made possible through the benevolence of your king."

1118.speaker: Player_Romus
1118.text: "Let the Princess' marriage bond be an inspiration to us all. I hope that I myself may someday find a love as pure."

1129.speaker: Player_Romus
1129.text: "As the chefs bring out our lovingly prepared meal, remember that this is a day for unity, not discord."

1149.speaker: Player_Romus
1149.text: "I dedicate this day to those who have brought me solace, comfort and unconditional support throughout my reign. You know who you are."

1150.speaker: Narrator
1150.text: I could feel all eyes on our table as the guests broke into speculative whispers.

1155.speaker: Narrator

1159.text: Duke Reinhart wore a look of pure consternation.

1163.speaker: Narrator
1163.text: My daughter wore a look of pure consternation.
1163.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true) == false)

1165.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1165.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Deranked"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == false

1166.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1166.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Deranked"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == false) == false

1167.speaker: Narrator
1167.text: I saw Taddeus Azaro furiously applauding from his wheelchair. The other Azaros in the hall followed suit.
1167.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Deranked"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == false

1168.speaker: Narrator
1168.text: Everyone from House Azaro began applauding furiously.
1168.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Deranked"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == false) == false

1169.speaker: Narrator
1169.text: I heard speculative whispers from various corners of the hall.

1171.speaker: Player_Romus
1171.text: "We raise our glasses not only to the newlyweds, but to a future without conflict."
1171.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false)

1172.speaker: Narrator
1172.text: The hall echoed with polite applause.

1173.speaker: Narrator
1173.text: The hall echoed with polite laughter.

1174.speaker: Player_Romus
1174.text: "I vow that by this time next year, Rizia and Pales shall be one!"
1174.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true)

1178.speaker: Player_Romus
1178.text: "Let us lift our cups in anticipation of the day when everyone in Rizia is free."
1178.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true)

1182.speaker: Player_Romus
1182.text: "Let us lift our cups to the monarchic traditions which sustain us all."
1182.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false)

1183.speaker: Player_Romus
1183.text: "A toast to my wonderful daughter. Vina, I will always love and cherish you, no matter your path in life."
1183.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumApproved"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false)

1184.speaker: Player_Romus
1184.text: "A final toast to love, and to its power to build bridges that last beyond our lifetimes."

1185.speaker: Narrator
1185.text: Everyone in the hall lifted their glasses high.

1202.speaker: Player_Romus
1202.text: "Vina, no matter whom I love, I promise that you will still be the most important person in my life."

1203.speaker: Player_Romus
1203.text: "We shall lead our troops to victory, hand in hand!"

1204.speaker: Player_Romus
1204.text: "I look forward to this new epoch of cooperation between House Toras and House Azaro, just as I rejoice in the new bonds my daughter's marriage brings."

1205.speaker: Narrator
1205.text: The volume in the hall instantly dropped down to nothing. All eyes were on me.

1206.speaker: Player_Romus
1206.text: "I invite you all to cast off the shackles of history and tradition. Free your minds, and the rest will follow!"

1210.speaker: Player_Romus
1210.text: "Hand in hand, we shall protect this kingdom and everything it stands for!"

1214.speaker: Player_Romus
1214.text: "I invite you to raise your glass to love, and to its ability to build bridges that last longer than lifetimes."

1215.speaker: Narrator
1215.text: Vina had a dubious look on her face.

1216.speaker: Player_Romus
1216.text: "A final toast to the Princess of Rizia. May her beauty, intelligence and grace inspire us all."

1217.speaker: Player_Romus
1217.text: "Let us lift our cups to freedom. It is coming sooner than we think."

1221.speaker: Player_Romus
1221.text: "Let us lift our cups to our golden kingdom and the glorious future that awaits us."

1222.speaker: Narrator
1222.text: Everyone in the hall lifted their glasses high, still somewhat bewildered.

1223.speaker: Narrator
1223.text: All of our Wruhecist guests repeated the word. The hall filled with the sound of clinking glasses.

1224.speaker: Narrator
1224.text: All of our Rizian guests repeated the words. The hall filled with the sound of clinking glasses.

1225.speaker: Narrator
1225.text: All of our guests repeated the words. The hall filled with the sound of clinking glasses.

1229.speaker: Narrator
1229.text: As the others at my table sipped their wine, I saw grimaces appear on their faces.
1229.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false)

1231.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1231.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false

1232.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1232.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false) == false

1233.speaker: Narrator
1233.text: I took a sip of wine. An acrid, unpleasant taste spread in my mouth.
1233.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false)

1234.speaker: Narrator
1234.text: Pabel leaned over and whispered in my ear.

1235.speaker: Pabel Adria
1235.text: "It's corked, Rom. I knew I shouldn't have abandoned my duties today."

1236.speaker: Narrator
1236.text: I took a sip of wine. It was delicious.
1236.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)   and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false) == false)

1238.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1238.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false

1239.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1239.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false) == false

1240.speaker: Narrator
1240.text: As the others at my table sipped their wine, I saw smiles on their faces.
1240.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_WeddingCommittee"] == false) == false)

1241.speaker: Pabel Adria
1241.text: "The Cantuavos have outdone themselves. This one might be their masterpiece."

1244.speaker: Player_Romus
1244.text: "A sweet finish to this sweetest of days."

1245.speaker: Player_Romus
1245.text: "It doesn't matter. Nothing can ruin this day."

1247.speaker: Player_Romus
1247.text: "You're here with me. That's worth a little spoilt wine."

1248.speaker: Narrator
1248.text: I looked once more at my daughter.

1255.speaker: Narrator
1255.text: The light from the chandeliers glinted off Lena's ring on her finger.

1259.speaker: Narrator
1259.text: She slouched in her seat as Rico and Hugo huddled together, speaking in concerned whispers.
1259.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true)

1263.speaker: Narrator
1263.text: She and Axel were huddled together, speaking in concerned whispers.
1263.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true)

1264.speaker: Narrator
1264.text: She and Manus were huddled together, speaking in concerned whispers.
1264.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true) == false)

1271.speaker: Narrator
1271.text: She slouched in her seat as Rico and Hugo talked to each other animatedly.
1271.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true)

1272.speaker: Narrator
1272.text: She and Axel were talking to each other animatedly, their full wine glasses all but forgotten.
1272.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true)

1273.speaker: Narrator
1273.text: She and Manus were talking to each other animatedly, their full wine glasses all but forgotten.
1273.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_WearsLenasRing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true) == false)

1274.speaker: Narrator
1274.text: I knew that it wasn't the wine they were talking about.

1275.speaker: Narrator
1275.text: I knew she'd remember today forever.

1276.speaker: Narrator
1276.text: I knew she couldn't wait to set off for Valenqiris.

1280.speaker: Narrator
1280.text: I knew she was counting the hours until her new husband's departure.

1286.speaker: Narrator
1286.text: Sordland's vice president bowed low to the ground, wobbling slightly as he straightened up.

1287.speaker: Narrator
1287.text: The sun was just beginning to rise as Hugo and I convened in the council chambers to discuss our strategy.

1288.speaker: Hugo Toras
1288.text: "This is quite the predicament, my dear nephew."

1289.speaker: Rico Toras
1289.text: "And now she's, what, left me at the altar? Do you have any idea how humiliating this is for me?"

1290.speaker: Narrator
1290.text: He started pacing around the room.

1291.speaker: Rico Toras
1291.text: "I'm not an idiot. I knew Her Highness didn't want to marry me. But I assumed you'd convinced her, just as Father convinced me."

1292.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1292.text: "You did obtain her consent for the marriage, yes? I was under the impression she would be an enthusiastic participant."

1296.speaker: Hugo Toras
1296.text: "This is quite the predicament, Your Majesty."

1297.speaker: Hugo Toras
1297.text: "House Toras has been eagerly anticipating this wedding for the past year. Now we've got to explain that it's been canceled because the Princess got cold feet?"

1301.speaker: Hugo Toras
1301.text: "The entire kingdom has been eagerly anticipating our reunion with Pales. Now we've got to explain that it's been canceled because the Princess got cold feet?"

1302.speaker: Player_Romus
1302.text: "It's my fault. I never should have forced Vina into marriage."

1303.speaker: Player_Romus
1303.text: "She didn't suddenly get cold feet. She planned this deliberately to humiliate me."

1304.speaker: Player_Romus
1304.text: "We can accomplish this union without a wedding. Pales is joining our new South Merkopan alliance, after all."

1308.speaker: Player_Romus
1308.text: "Postponed, not canceled. There's still a chance we can track her down."

1309.speaker: Player_Romus
1309.text: "People will understand. Women change their mind all the time."

1311.speaker: Hugo Toras
1311.text: "You were 'forced' into such a pairing yourself, Your Majesty. But you understood that your primary duty was to your kingdom and your house, not your own juvenile whims."

1312.speaker: Hugo Toras
1312.text: "Well, that's certainly not something we want to tell the press."

1313.speaker: Hugo Toras
1313.text: "It's too late for that, Your Majesty."

1314.speaker: Hugo Toras
1314.text: "Not heirs to the throne of Rizia."

1315.speaker: Hugo Toras
1315.text: "You were in this position yourself. You understood that your primary duty was to your kingdom and your house, not your own juvenile whims."

1316.speaker: Hugo Toras
1316.text: "It's still a mystery to me. Her Highness should have understood that her duty was to her kingdom and her house, not her own juvenile whims."

1317.speaker: Hugo Toras
1317.text: "Forcing our Crown Princess out of hiding and dragging her to the altar? It's not going to look good."

1318.speaker: Hugo Toras
1318.text: "That remains to be seen, doesn't it?"

1322.speaker: Player_Romus
1322.text: "Perhaps none of this matters. If all goes well, there will be a second Toras heir."

1323.speaker: Player_Romus
1323.text: "Vina has always been stubborn. Just like her grandfather."

1325.speaker: Hugo Toras
1325.text: "What precisely do you mean by that?"

1326.speaker: Player_Romus
1326.text: "Duchess Azaro and I are in love. And as of yesterday, she is Rizia's new Queen Consort."

1327.speaker: Player_Romus
1327.text: "Lucita and I were married in secret last night. We plan on bearing many children."

1328.speaker: Player_Romus
1328.text: "The second I heard of Vina's escape, I asked for Duchess Azaro's hand. As a contingency plan."

1329.speaker: Player_Romus
1329.text: "I would have thought you'd be happier. If Vina never returns, you and Rico are next in line for the throne."

1330.speaker: Player_Romus
1330.text: "She wasn't acting alone. My mother and Pabel encouraged her."

1332.speaker: Hugo Toras
1332.text: "I wish you had consulted your Grand Vizier before making such a drastic decision."

1333.speaker: Hugo Toras
1333.text: "But this is good news. Have a child with the Azaro heiress, and our house will happily accept him as the new successor."

1337.speaker: Hugo Toras
1337.text: "Nobody should know about this yet, let alone Duke Reinhart. He may believe you never intended for him to get close to the Rizian throne."

1342.speaker: Hugo Toras
1342.text: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius' arrest is still fresh in the public's mind. We can't have it look as if member after member of the royal household is turning against us."

1343.speaker: Hugo Toras
1343.text: "Treason within the royal household.... it will only confirm what the world's non-monarchies already think of us."

1344.speaker: Hugo Toras
1344.text: "What is that worth if our kingdom is an international laughing stock?"

1345.speaker: Hugo Toras
1345.text: "Perhaps King Valero's branch of House Toras indeed lacks the proper temperament to reign. Yourself excepted, of course."

1347.speaker: Hugo Toras
1347.text: "What about the Golden Guard? Framing this incident as a security breach may smooth over some of the potential damage."

1348.speaker: Player_Romus
1348.text: "It's true. Titus and his men should never have allowed Vina out of their sights."

1349.speaker: Player_Romus
1349.text: "That wouldn't be fair. It wasn't Captain Gordion's fault that Vina wanted to escape in the first place."

1350.speaker: Player_Romus
1350.text: "I can't risk blaming the Golden Guard. I need Titus to stay loyal to me."

1353.speaker: Hugo Toras
1353.text: "It's true that I would have preferred to see my son crowned Prince Consort. But a closer Toras-Azaro alliance will benefit everyone in the long run."

1354.speaker: Hugo Toras
1354.text: "We'll discuss the full ramifications later. For now, we need an immediate response."

1355.speaker: Hugo Toras
1355.text: "My son will get over it. The news may even come as a relief to him."

1356.speaker: Player_Romus
1356.text: "Of course they will. What choice do they have?"

1358.speaker: Hugo Toras
1358.text: "This doesn't change our need for a direct response to the Vina incident, though."

1359.speaker: Hugo Toras
1359.text: "The Royal Family's security is supposed to be his top priority. But he's lost sight of it since being named to your council."

1366.speaker: Hugo Toras
1366.text: "The Royal Family's security is supposed to be his top priority. But he's lost sight of it since his task force was expanded."

1367.speaker: Hugo Toras
1367.text: "The man obviously wants to be more than a mere bodyguard. He may have thought basic security duties were beneath him."

1368.speaker: Hugo Toras
1368.text: "What is his loyalty worth after such a large misstep?"

1369.speaker: Hugo Toras
1369.text: "Had his men managed to keep her from leaving the palace, you might have been able to persuade her to go through with the wedding."

1370.speaker: Player_Romus
1370.text: "It was a single individual who let Vina escape, not the Guard as a whole."

1371.speaker: Hugo Toras
1371.text: "But who recruited that individual? Who assured us that every single member of his team was incorruptible? Titus Gordion."

1372.speaker: Narrator
1372.text: There was a knock on the door. An aide announced the arrival of Rico Toras.

1376.speaker: Rico Toras
1376.text: "Father, Your Majesty. What's going on? Nobody's told me a damn thing."

1377.speaker: Player_Romus
1377.text: "I regret to inform you that the wedding has been canceled due to a lack of bride."

1378.speaker: Player_Romus
1378.text: "There's been a security breach. The Princess has disappeared."

1379.speaker: Player_Romus
1379.text: "Vina's gone, Ricardus. It's likely she fled the country."

1383.speaker: Narrator
1383.text: He was quiet for a moment as he processed this information.

1384.speaker: Player_Romus
1384.text: "I promise she was excited for the wedding. Her escape came out of nowhere."

1385.speaker: Player_Romus
1385.text: "Relax, Rico. We're putting the full blame on the Golden Guard. Your reputation won't suffer."

1386.speaker: Player_Romus
1386.text: "I tried to convince her. But you know how stubborn she is."

1389.speaker: Narrator
1389.text: Rico eyed me dubiously. Hugo gave him a nod.

1390.speaker: Player_Romus
1390.text: "Don't act surprised. My daughter was always too good for you."

1391.speaker: Narrator
1391.text: Hugo and Rico both glared at me.

1395.speaker: Rico Toras
1395.text: "But I understand. You don't want me near the throne, I'll assume you don't want Su Omina anywhere near it, either."

1396.speaker: Rico Toras
1396.text: "So this whole time, you knew she might run away? And you did nothing to prevent it?"

1400.speaker: Rico Toras
1400.text: "This debacle is going to cause quite a bit of upheaval in the coming months. You'll forgive Su Omina if they fail to receive the occasional order."

1401.speaker: Hugo Toras
1401.text: "His Majesty is right, son. We don't even know whether Her Highness wanted to leave. This could be a second royal kidnapping."

1402.speaker: Rico Toras
1402.text: "Nonetheless... this debacle is going to cause quite a bit of upheaval in the coming months. You'll forgive Su Omina if they fail to receive the occasional order."

1408.speaker: Rico Toras
1408.text: "Well... thank you for letting me know."

1409.speaker: Rico Toras
1409.text: "Since we all now have the day free, I'll see which of our visiting guests are up for a last-minute hunting trip."

1410.speaker: Rico Toras
1410.text: "But I would never dare to disagree with you, Your Majesty."

1411.speaker: Narrator
1411.text: There was a knock on the door. An aide announced the arrival of Duke Reinhart.

1412.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1412.text: "I came as soon as I could, Your Majesty. What's the emergency?"

1413.speaker: Player_Romus
1413.text: "I regret to inform you that the wedding has been canceled due to a lack of bride."

1414.speaker: Player_Romus
1414.text: "There's been a security breach. The Princess has disappeared."

1415.speaker: Player_Romus
1415.text: "Vina's gone, Duke Reinhart. It's likely she fled the country."

1419.speaker: Narrator
1419.text: He slowly sat down. The wheels in his head seemed to be turning as he processed the information I'd given him.

1420.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1420.text: "Funny. Usually I'm the one running away from women who want to marry me, not the other way around."

1421.speaker: Player_Romus
1421.text: "She was extremely enthusiastic. Right up until yesterday."

1422.speaker: Player_Romus
1422.text: "We don't know exactly what happened. All I know is that our Golden Guard failed to do their job and will be reprimanded accordingly."

1423.speaker: Player_Romus
1423.text: "I tried my best. I thought she would come around to the idea in time."

1424.speaker: Rico Toras
1424.text: "If that's the way you felt, why did you agree to the marriage in the first place?"

1426.speaker: Rico Toras
1426.text: "I will not question your judgement, Your Majesty."

1433.speaker: Narrator
1433.text: He turned and abruptly left the room.

1435.speaker: Narrator
1435.text: Axel crossed his arms and stared me down.

1436.speaker: Narrator
1436.text: Axel eyed the two of us dubiously.

1437.speaker: Hugo Toras
1437.text: "We are committed to getting to the bottom of this, Your Grace. Whether or not Her Highness is found, a full overhaul of our security protocol is in order."

1439.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1439.text: "A case of last-minute jitters I would understand. But fleeing entirely..."

1440.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1440.text: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans. I'll have to take another look at that alliance proposal as well."

1444.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1444.text: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans, but I suppose our participation in the alliance you're planning need not be affected."

1445.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1445.text: "An arranged marriage is one thing. A forced marriage is another."

1446.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1446.text: "So you would have married your daughter to me against her will."

1450.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1450.text: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans. I'll have to seriously think about our other arrangements as well."

1451.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1451.text: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans, but I suppose our other arrangements need not be affected."

1453.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1453.text: "If you'll excuse me, I've got to inform the rest of my family."

1455.speaker: Hugo Toras
1455.text: "So we are blaming the Golden Guard for what happened. A sound strategy."

1460.speaker: Hugo Toras
1460.text: "That could have gone better, Your Majesty."

1461.speaker: Narrator
1461.text: My uncle sighed and rearranged some documents on the table in front of him.

1462.speaker: Hugo Toras
1462.text: "I'll tell our communications team to get straight on it."
1462.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_LucitaMarried_HugoKnows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false)

1463.speaker: Hugo Toras
1463.text: "I'll tell our communications team to go into damage control mode."

1464.speaker: Hugo Toras
1464.text: "In the meantime, you ought to keep a low profile, Your Majesty."
1464.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_LucitaMarried_HugoKnows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false)

1472.speaker: Hugo Toras
1472.text: "Announcing your marriage to Duchess Azaro should serve as a welcome distraction as well. I'll tell our communications team to get straight on it."

1479.speaker: Hugo Toras
1479.text: "At least announcing your marriage to Duchess Azaro should serve as a welcome distraction. I'll send out a press statement at once."

1480.speaker: Narrator
1480.text: We wrapped up our meeting and left the council chambers.

1483.speaker: Player_Romus
1483.text: "Chilling wine of this caliber is an insult to the vintners."

1487.speaker: Estela Toras
1487.text: "He's also the only person in this household who'd appreciate my hat, by the way."

1491.speaker: Narrator
1491.text: Hugo and his wife Rita were next to arrive at our table.
1491.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_WeddingDate"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false) == false)

1495.speaker: Narrator
1495.text: My mother leaned over and whispered in my ear.

1496.speaker: Estela Toras
1496.text: "Even chilling couldn't salvage this batch. Where's your butler when you need him?"

1497.speaker: Player_Romus
1497.text: "Quiet, Mother. Maybe the other guests didn't notice."

1498.speaker: Estela Toras
1498.text: "Why, this one doesn't need chilling at all. I still wonder what happened to Pabel, though."

1511.speaker: Narrator
1511.text: Hugo had returned to Porte Drazon for the wedding. We convened in the council chambers to talk about Vina's disappearance.

1513.speaker: Hugo Toras
1513.text: "First Rico, now Her Highness... I don't understand what's happening but it seems our family is falling apart."

1514.speaker: Player_Romus
1514.text: "You are no longer the Grand Vizier. I don't need your consultation."

1515.speaker: Player_Romus
1515.text: "It's my fault. I never should have forced Vina into marriage."

1516.speaker: Player_Romus
1516.text: "She didn't suddenly get cold feet. She planned this deliberately to humiliate me."

1517.speaker: Player_Romus
1517.text: "Postponed, not canceled. There's still a chance we can track her down."

1518.speaker: Player_Romus
1518.text: "People will understand. Women change their mind all the time."

1520.speaker: Hugo Toras
1520.text: "Well, that's certainly not something you want to tell the press."

1522.speaker: Hugo Toras
1522.text: "Not heirs to the throne of Rizia."

1523.speaker: Hugo Toras
1523.text: "The entire kingdom has been eagerly anticipating our reunion with Pales. Now you've got to explain that it's been canceled because the Princess got cold feet?"

1524.speaker: Hugo Toras
1524.text: "I am still a Toras. And despite mounting evidence to the contrary, I still believe that name is worth something."

1527.speaker: Hugo Toras
1527.text: "I know I'm no longer Vizier, but take this as my final piece of advice. This is not only about Princess Vina, but about the Royal Family's standing as a whole."

1528.speaker: Hugo Toras
1528.text: "After what you've done to Ricardus, you cannot risk this being portrayed as another betrayal from House Toras."

1532.speaker: Player_Romus
1532.text: "Thank you for the advice, Hugo. But I don't need your help anymore."

1536.speaker: Hugo Toras
1536.text: "So you are blaming the Golden Guard for what happened. A sound strategy."

1541.speaker: Narrator
1541.text: We wrapped up our meeting and left the council chambers.

1543.speaker: Hugo Toras
1543.text: "I will take my leave back to Monqiz."

1548.speaker: Player_Romus
1548.text: "You didn't need to join the ceremony, Hugo."

1549.speaker: Hugo Toras
1549.text: "It's my son's wedding, Your Majesty. Grand Vizier or not, I have to be here."

1557.speaker: Narrator
1557.text: Sensing the tension in our voices, Pabel and Rita looked away awkwardly.

1558.speaker: Narrator
1558.text: He raised an eyebrow. He seemed annoyed.

1559.speaker: Narrator
1559.text: Suddenly, a string quartet struck up a stately march as the bride and groom made their entrance.

1563.speaker: Player_Romus
1563.text: "We can accomplish this union without a wedding. Pales is joining GRACE, after all."

1593.speaker: Petr Vectern (R)
1593.text: "Don't get me wrong, I love Sordland. But Rizia's taste for the finer things is unparalleled."
